admission.justification: Realized across src/rh_pipeline/models/lean.py and src/rh_pipeline/models/dag.py with unit tests verifying exact-key deserialization, skeleton-relative path enforcement and canonical JSON, preventing silent schema drift or malformed skeleton paths.

applicability: Immutable Phase 1 Lean declaration and DAG domain dataclasses and canonical JSON formatting in src/rh_pipeline/models/lean.py and src/rh_pipeline/models/dag.py.
conditions: Every dataclass is frozen with slots and validates exact key sets, non-boolean integers and strict types in __post_init__ and from_dict.

StageFileMapping and DagNode enforce relative POSIX paths and reject any leading skeleton/ prefix on skeleton_file; StageMap and DagGraph pin exact schema versions rh-stage-map/v1 and rh-dag/v1 and format sorted-key JSON with a trailing newline.
exclusions: Cross-entry uniqueness and consecutive stage ordering are enforced in graph/stage_map.py, and LeanDeclaration relies on lean/parser.py to sort imports and compute body_sha256.
statement: Phase 1 Lean declaration and DAG domain models are immutable frozen dataclasses with strict exact-key from_dict validation, relative POSIX path enforcement (rejecting skeleton/ prefix on skeleton_file), bool-rejected integer checks, and deterministic sorted-key canonical JSON formatting.
title: Immutable Phase 1 Lean/DAG models and canonical JSON
